li.p: If Lane change assist (Highway) is selected, it helps change lanes safely.
If there is a problem with the functions, the settings cannot be changed. Have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
If the vehicle is turned off and restarted, the functions will maintain the last setting.
Be sure to park in a safe place before setting the function.

When the trailer’s connector is plugged into your vehicle, Highway Driving Assist automatically turns off. In this case, you cannot get help Highway Driving Assist. Pay extra attention when you drive when the function is inactive. (If a Kia genuine Trailer Kit that can determine whether a trailer is connected is used)
